Description
AI and Cybersecurity: Strategies for Resilience and Defense is a four-week, live online program from MIT xPRO designed for senior technology leaders, cybersecurity professionals, and risk and IT managers. This program explores how artificial intelligence and machine learning are reshaping the cybersecurity landscape and how you can stay ahead of evolving threats. Through interactive live sessions with MIT faculty and real-world case studies, you will gain practical tools to build resilient, AI-integrated security strategies, navigate the risks of AI-driven systems, and lead with confidence at the critical intersection of cybersecurity and emerging technology.
